milestone: MSCA-DN assessment framework, ticket R03 of plans/pe08_review_and_pe09_handoff_tickets.md: adjudicate the semantic false positives and the ESR matching the R02 review handed on, and correct the audit rules that compare unlike relations
authority: CLAUDE.md §9.1 (docs/ is the durable record), §9.4 (a decision that affects future interpretation is written here), §9.5 (an output is reproducible from its documented inputs), §10.5 (every material claim names its tiered source), §10.6 (Tier 1 and Tier 2 sources govern; generic programme knowledge is a last resort and must be flagged), §11.2 (Tier 2A governs instrument structure), §12.2 (the four status categories), §12.3 (a contradiction is resolved explicitly and the resolution recorded), §13.2 (no invented call constraint), §15 (explicit failure over fabricated completion).

problem.basis: the seven rows the R02 review notes recommend 'revisit_in_r03', read in the committed artifacts
problem.statement: A deterministic comparison can be syntactically correct and still compare two different relationships. Eleven of the 40 findings in the audit the dispositions cite rested on such a comparison, and three ESR rows were credited to a lane on evidence about something else.
detail: Nine findings said a 36-month appointment starting M5 ends after the work packages it names. Every package ends M36, so the rule fired once per candidate on the same arithmetic.

Two findings said WP6 and WP7 declare DC1-9 while no DC project in 1.1 names either. Training and impact packages involve the whole cohort and appear on no host line, so set equality cannot hold for them in any compliant proposal.
Sixteen findings said a milestone names no deliverable it depends on. The milestones table the application form fixes has no dependency column.
One blind shortcoming said no intermediate milestones are shown. The implementation section the assessor received carries the milestones table with a due month for each of 16 milestones.
ESR-E-04's partial detection rested on a finding about sample sizes, where the ESR faults a multihospital, multi-operator design.

decision.basis: the adjudication record, the rule corrections and the verification below
decision.two_halves_per_row: Every adjudication separates a measured half from an interpretation half and gives each its own §12.2 status. A01's measurement is Confirmed and its reading is Confirmed; A04's measurement is Confirmed and its reading Unresolved, because the candidate declares no project duration and Tier 2B holds no extract for this call. A reader can see where the evidence stops.
decision.tier2a_is_the_authority_for_what_a_table: The two rule corrections rest on the MSCA-DN Part B application form, not on programme knowledge (§10.6, §11.2). Table 3.1d's duration column reads '3-36 (up to 48 for DN-JD)' and ties the appointment to nothing else. Table 3.1a asks applicants to say which organisation and DCs will do each task. Table 3.1c carries number, title, related work package(s), lead beneficiary, due date and means of verification, and no dependency. Each quote is checked against the form's own bytes by a test.
decision.the_limit_of_the_overlap_test_is_declare: One month of overlap passes it, so the appointment's end is noted and never judged. A stronger test would need a premise no source gives, and the obvious candidate is false: a 36-month appointment cannot cover a 36-month package unless it starts in month 1. Overlap is the strongest sound test available, and A01 says so rather than leaving a reader to find it.
decision.corrections_are_general: No WP4, M7.3 or page-specific exception was added. DCs involved is compared by containment in the one direction the two statements support, so WP1, WP2 and WP4 are still reported and name the omitted candidates. The appointment window is compared for overlap, so a candidate employed outside the package they contribute to is still reported — a case the old rule never tested. Representative positive and negative cases are in the audit suite.
decision.an_absence_is_noted_not_re_kinded: The 16 milestone findings keep their kind and their text. Re-kinding them would break every reference the committed comparison recorded into that report, and the ticket asks for the distinction in prose rather than in an enum. A check note states that a dependency is not a column, so the kind is not read as a violation.
decision.which_vocabularies_were_extended_and_why: Item 6 forbids changing an existing report enum silently. Two report enums were candidates and neither changed: the audit's finding kinds and the comparison's dispositions. Every reference an earlier artifact recorded into them still resolves. What did gain a value is the review notes' own recommendation vocabulary, which R02 introduced for the declared half: 'adjudicated' says a later ticket took the row up. That is not silent — it is in the module constant, in the notes' own vocabulary list, in harness/HARNESS.md, and under test, and the loader still demands an operator_decision for such a row. The adjudication record coins its own vocabularies rather than borrowing any report's.
decision.the_record_adds_two_classes_and_defines_: The ticket names five classes and two cases need a sixth and seventh. A blind-lane statement contradicted by the input that lane received is none of the five: nothing was mis-extracted and nothing was removed by sanitisation. That is 'unsupported_lane_claim' (A05, A10). A dispute the review raised that the measurement does not sustain is none of them either, because the row stands as recorded and no comparison was mis-framed. That is 'dispute_not_sustained' (A07, where the baseline turns out to say nothing about the evaluation design in any sample or cell). The record defines all seven, so each label is defensible from the artifact itself, and no enum of any existing report is changed.
decision.the_missed_rows_differ_in_kind: A failure_mode separates a point no lane output engages with (ESR-E-03: the frozen baseline never uses the words prospective, shadow or retrospective) from a passage a lane read and rated adequate (ESR-E-07, ESR-E-09, each cited approvingly by its cell's own members) and one a lane read and misattributed (ESR-Q-02: four of five samples credit the deliverables table with the milestones table's verification column). The distinction is recorded and no rate uses it.
decision.the_review_is_regenerated_not_edited: R02's notes and its rendered report stay byte-unchanged. R03 writes a second notes record and renders a second report from it. The R02 decision record expected the regeneration to run over a successor comparison; it does not, because writing a successor comparison is R05's step. The review therefore reads the same comparison with the adjudicated reading, and each committed report now names the notes record it was rendered from so the first stays reproducible.
decision.nothing_is_approved: Every adjudicated row carries recommendation 'adjudicated' and still names an operator_decision. review_state has one permitted value and no 'approved' value exists. An adjudication is a reading for review.
